content.text:
**Analyzing Grid Structure**

I'm focusing on the input grid's bipartition. A magenta line at row 7 clearly separates the upper half (rows 0-6) from the lower half (rows 8-13). Both sections are characterized by a prevalence of yellow (4) pixels, indicating a symmetrical pattern across this dividing line.

**Investigating Grid Transformation**

I'm puzzled by the clearing of rows 8-13. It seems to stem from a comparison between the upper and lower halves of the grid. I'm examining the connectivity and symmetry of the yellow (4) pixels in each section to understand the underlying logic.
